article.title: Venezuela’s battle for sovereignty continues
article.author: Roger Harris
article.content: The U.S. attack of Jan. 3 killed over 100 persons and succeeded in kidnapping President Nicolás Maduro and First Lady Cilia Flores, an elected member of the National Assembly. The post Venezuela’s battle for sovereignty continues appeared first on MR Online .
